timingMethod: performance.now around Playwright file selection or editor input through observed result; includes automation, 50ms polling (prompt), debounce, file reads and worker initialization (document). Not isolated CPU time.

memory.method: Chrome performance.memory after workload; coarse renderer snapshots, may share isolate/process and exclude document workers, browser, and peak memory. Not attributable extension overhead.
